flower_detail.method: Four crossed alpha-tested detail layers around each modeled bract volume, with cultivar pigmentation blending.

lighting_maps: Normal and roughness data are derived at runtime from the original albedo; the image is an original generated artistic asset, not a measured scan.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium 3D botanical PBR albedo texture atlas for a lifelike cannabis plant AR art animation. Generate ONE high-resolution square image with exactly FOUR equal square texture panels arranged in a 2 by 2 grid. No margins, borders, dividers, labels, text, silhouettes, shadows, pots or environment. Each panel is a completely full-bleed rectangular surface patch under flat diffuse cross-polarized scan lighting, no baked directional highlights. TOP LEFT: detailed healthy deep natural green cannabis leaflet surface, central vertical midrib exactly centered, base direction at bottom and tip direction at top, many fine diagonal branching veinlets, tiny epidermal cells and very subtle natural mottling, continuous leaf tissue fills entire square with no outer outline. TOP RIGHT: same leaf tissue but olive green with subtle burgundy-purple vein pigmentation and natural variation, vertical centered midrib and finer veinlets. BOTTOM LEFT: extreme macro of real fresh female cannabis inflorescence surface, interlocking small green bracts, tiny sugar leaves, fine translucent glandular trichomes and curled cream/light amber pistils, organic granular relief, no single daisy-like petals; the continuous surface entirely fills the panel. BOTTOM RIGHT: equivalent dense inflorescence surface with rich plum and violet bracts among olive green sugar leaf tips, milky trichomes and warm amber/cream pistils, organic fine detail. Photographic 2K material detail, restrained natural colors, botanical realism, no plastic or illustration. Exactly square grid, all four material panels occupy precise quarters, no white gaps. These will be UV-mapped onto fully modeled leaves and flower clusters, not displayed as a picture.
